title: Every Service-facing port in the Helm chart must read mlflow.servicePort, not the container port
answers: helm service port differs from container port mlflow
expose mlflow on port 80 with the kubernetes helm chart
cronjob MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI wrong port after changing service port
helm NOTES shows wrong port for LoadBalancer or port-forward
body:
Symptom: a user cannot expose MLflow through the Helm chart on a conventional port (e.g. 80) while the server listens on 5000. After such a change, the garbage-collection CronJob's tracking URI or the NOTES.txt URL/port-forward hint still shows the container port.
Root cause: charts/templates/service.yaml, cronjob.yaml and NOTES.txt all derived their port from server.value_options.port, so the Service port and the container port were the same value.
Fix pattern: resolve the Service port only through the define mlflow.servicePort in charts/templates/_helpers.tpl (service.port, falling back to server.value_options.port). Use it in every consumer that addresses the Service: the Service port, the MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI in charts/templates/cronjob.yaml, and the remote side of the port-forward and LoadBalancer hints in charts/templates/NOTES.txt. Keep the container port and targetPort on server.value_options.port and the named http/https port.
Constraints: the helper uses `default`, so an empty or 0 service.port falls back to the server port. Keep service.port default "" in charts/values.yaml so an unset value preserves the old behaviour. The local port in the port-forward hint stays server.value_options.port, as the diff does.
applies: Any template or value change that touches Service ports, Service-addressed URLs or NOTES hints in the MLflow Helm chart.
says: Post-installation instructions show the container port instead of the configured Kubernetes service port.
Scheduled garbage collection jobs fail to connect after changing the service port.
Expose the tracking server on port eighty while the container listens on another port.
Load balancer setup instructions show the wrong port after configuring a custom service port.
Port-forward instructions in Helm release notes should target the custom service port.
search: Service-facing ports in the MLflow Helm chart must resolve through the mlflow.servicePort define in charts/templates/_helpers.tpl rather than server.value_options.port. This helper falls back to server.value_options.port when service.port is empty or 0, preserving default behavior when charts/values.yaml sets service.port to empty string. It must be used for the Service port, the MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI in charts/templates/cronjob.yaml, and remote port hints in charts/templates/NOTES.txt. The container port, targetPort, and local port in port-forward hints remain on server.value_options.port.
